title: ParametricWindProfiles: analysis code and processed data for a comparison of parametric TC wind profiles in the western North Pacific
description: Python code and processed JTWC/IBTrACS best-track derivatives that reproduce all tables and figures in Zerrudo & Bala (2026), 'A Comparison of Parametric Tropical Cyclone Wind Profiles for the Western North Pacific' (Tropical Cyclone Research and Review). Includes the wind-profile library, five analysis scripts, the pre-generated Tao (2026) predictions, and a full set of reference outputs.
